 The WBBL Brisbane Heat have called on talented wicket-keeper/batter Mikayla Wrigley to join their squad for tomorrow night’s Weber Women’s Big Bash League game in Melbourne.
 Wrigley replaces batter Lucy Bourke, who was ruled out under concussion protocols after being injured during the warm-ups at Allan Border Field on Saturday prior to the Heat’s victory over the Hobart Hurricanes.
She is the only change to the squad which is chasing its third victory on the trot when it takes on the Melbourne Stars at Junction Oval tomorrow.
Indian international Yastika Bhatia will be in action against her former WBBL club tomorrow.
The Heat have won their past two games to sit in the top four of the competition.
 The match will be broadcast and streamed on Channel Seven, 7plus, Foxtel and Kayo and broadcast on ABC Radio and ABC Listen App.
 Weber Women's Big Bash League
Melbourne Stars v Brisbane Heat
Junction Oval, tomorrow, 2.40pm Qld time

 The centre circle represents the Gabba, alongside other water holes which used to be near the ground. 87 black strokes on red earth represent the wickets taken by Aboriginal great, Eddie Gilbert who played 23 games for Queensland.
